info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Stibnite Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Stibnite Notebook Detail Management API enables users to create and manage detailed entries for Stibnite notebooks within the catalog. This endpoint supports adding new notebook details, ensuring that the catalog is up-to-date with the latest product specifications. Ideal for inventory management systems, product catalog applications, and e-commerce platforms, this API allows developers to streamline the cataloging process. Users can utilize this functionality to enhance product visibility and facilitate better customer engagement.
